note: The main banks: Handelsbanken, Swedbank, SEB and Nordea are Sweden's four large banks; on 2026-10-30 Swedbank's card pages answered with a captcha (not circumvented), SEB's and Nordea's credit card pages weren't found at their addresses, so only Handelsbanken is written. Handelsbanken's two credit cards, each from its own price list and page (read 2026-10-30): the Allkort, 360 kronor a year, with a debt rate currently 13.90% a year, a 1.65% currency exchange fee on purchases and withdrawals abroad, and no fee for a withdrawal at a cash machine in Sweden (so no cash fee is written; the 1%, at least 10 kronor, at a bank or exchange office isn't); and the Platinum, 2,400 kronor a year (included with a Premium agreement or as a Private Banking customer, which the game doesn't hold), 8.80% a year, 2% (at least 20 kronor) for a cash withdrawal at a machine in Sweden, the 1.65% currency fee, a 100-krone late fee and a 100-krone fee for going over the limit (the 45-krone reminder fee isn't written). Both have up to 45 interest-free days and a monthly invoice the holder may pay in part. The Allkort's price list gives no late or over-limit fee. Extra-card, replacement and courier prices aren't written. The earlier reading of the Allkort (2026-10-29) holds and is kept.
